experiment.goal_text: The final objective is lower routed cell area under the frozen routed setup/hold, electrical, GDS/DRC/LVS feasibility gates. Report routed timing headroom, repair edits and costs as separate secondary outcomes. Search promotion uses the same synthesis area/setup rule in both arms; physical results cannot change parent selection. Preserve the original ALU behavior for all 68 binary input bits. System functions including $signed/$unsigned are disallowed by the existing static gate; use explicit signed wires for signed operations.
experiment.primary_metric: confirmed_routed_area_gain_rel (arm-selected result, complete routed acceptance and repeat-synthesis confirmation required; 0 for confirmed original retained)

note: Frozen development comparison on RV32 ALU, three independent repetitions per arm. Both arms route the baseline and every functionally/mapping-valid proposal; only A3 sees physical observations. Search selection is synthesis-based for both; final primary outcome is routed area gain after full confirmation. Infrastructure-invalid v1 pre-run used 9 requests. Fresh v2 allows at most 4 requests per loop (24 total), making the global maximum 33 under the authorized 36. Queries consume this same request cap.
